b: Acme Tools has an excellent deal on the Milwaukee M12 Subcompact brushless cordless drill and impact driver combo kit, model 3494-22.
I love this kit. The tools are compact, they have brushless motors, and the performance is great for their size.
It’s been a $149 Black Friday deal all season at Milwaukee dealers.
Acme Tool shas it, one day only – or will supplies last – for $99.
Shipping is $6.49 or free at $199+. Use coupon code TOOLGUYD, which resets for everyone once every 30 days, for $10 off $79.
If you’re on the fence, buy it. I think this deal is good enough that it’s going to sell out early.
